localTools: FFmpeg with libx264, AAC, overlay, scale, crop, pad, concat, afade, sidechaincompress, amix and alimiter filters

providers.name: Social Publisher (Buffer MCP or API)
providers.purpose: Simultaneous headless publishing to YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and X.

notes: Run npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund once to install pinned Sharp 0.34.5 dependencies; setup requires network access but rendering does not.
Arial/Helvetica/sans-serif fonts are resolved on the host; inspect typography on each new platform. No model or font download is required.
All real gameplay and per-turn audio must be explicitly supplied and authorized; no voice cloning is implemented.
Bundled diagnostic video and sine tones are original mechanical fixtures only.
Optional music must be authorized and long enough for the episode. The bundled Dark Fog excerpt is CC BY 4.0 and requires the credit in MUSIC-CREDITS.md.
Only the available macOS environment was tested.
